description: This file defines the class 'SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase' which manages initialization, schema migration, and transaction handling for a SQLite database within the Chromium project. It includes methods for database setup, migration, committing pending operations, and error handling, intended to be subclassed for specific database implementations.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase
classes.description: A thread-safe reference-counted class that manages the lifecycle, schema, and transaction operations of a SQLite database, designed for subclassing to implement specific database behaviors.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Posts a task to flush pending database operations in the background; runs callback upon completion.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Commits pending operations and closes the database, to be called before destruction.

methods.name: SetBeforeCommitCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked before each commit operation.

methods.name: InitializeDatabase
methods.description: Initializes the database on a background thread, including schema migration and setup.

methods.name: RecordOpenDBProblem
methods.description: Virtual method to record metrics for database open problems.

methods.name: RecordDBMigrationProblem
methods.description: Virtual method to record metrics for database migration issues.

methods.name: DoMigrateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Pure virtual; performs database schema migration, returning new version or nullopt on error.

methods.name: CreateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Pure virtual; creates or verifies database schema, returning success status.

methods.name: DoInitializeDatabase
methods.description: Virtual; performs additional database initialization tasks, default returns true.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets and resets the database, e.g., in case of errors.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits pending operations to the database, invoked on background thread.

methods.name: DoCommit
methods.description: Pure virtual; contains logic to commit pending operations.

methods.name: PostBackgroundTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the background thread.

methods.name: PostClientTask
methods.description: Posts a task to the client thread.

methods.name: db
methods.description: Accessor for the underlying sql::Database object.
